messages.subject: No Maaslin format on Galaxy
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I'm trying to run Maaslin on the Huttenhower Galaxy page: http://huttenhower.org/galaxy and have run into a problem. The page says that the data needs to be uploaded as maaslin format, but that option doesn't exist in the type dropdown menu of the Upload data page (see screenshot).

Could you please tell me the correct format to run Maaslin on the Galaxy site? I tried tabular and that does not work.

Thanks,
Samantha

messages.subject: Query about Maaslin_Scale_in output file
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am using Maaslin through R based terminal mode remotely in my PC. With a variable of metadata and microbiome data, I got the association between few bacterias. But the scale of my variable CVD risk is only till 20 in X-Axis. Eventhough, I have many CVD risk values between the range of 20-60, But I could not see those in the association graph. Please find the attached for the input file and output for the reference. Can anyone help me to understand this issue? Many thanks in advance.
